parameters.description: The business identifier of the Explanation of Benefit

parameters.name: service-start-date
parameters.description: Starting Date of the service for the EOB. The service-start-date search parameter simplifies search, since a client doesn't need to know that for inpatient and outpatient institutional EOB dates they need to search by billablePeriod.start, for a pharmacy EOB by item.servicedDate, for a professional and non-clinician EOB - by item.servicedPeriod.start and for an oral EOB - by item.servicedPeriod.start.

parameters.name: billable-period-start
parameters.description: Starting Date of the service for the EOB using billablePeriod.period.start. The billable-period-start search parameter using the billablePeriod.period.start provides results with the earliest billablePeriod.start from a professional and non-clinician EOB or an oral EOB.
